The read depends on context, but the register itself does not. Across platforms the meaning is consistent, and the cadence stays the same. The receiver reads the combo the same whether it lands at the end of a sentence or as a stand-alone reaction. Most platforms render the two emojis side by side, but the read does not change with spacing.

faqs.question: How do I reply to 👋✨?
faqs.answer: Mirror 👋✨ with another reaction emoji or a sentence that joins the moment. The cleanest reply keeps the same intensity register.

faqs.question: Should I use 👋✨ in a complaint?
faqs.answer: 👋✨ can punctuate a complaint-coded message but rarely fixes one. Pair with text that names the issue so the reaction-coded emoji is reinforcement, not noise.

faqs.question: Is 👋✨ passive-aggressive on Slack?
faqs.answer: 👋✨ on Slack can read passive-aggressive when the send timing is late or paired with crisp text. Slack is asynchronous, so reactions travel sharper.

faqs.question: Is 👋✨ an insult?
faqs.answer: No. 👋✨ is reaction-coded rather than insult-coded. If the message lands as an insult, the surrounding text is doing the work.
